story_text: As a user, I want to reset my password via email so that I can regain access if I forget it.

positive.title: Reset password using valid email
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
positive.expected_result: A password reset link is sent to the registered email address.

positive.title: Reset password using valid email and validate the reset link
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
4. Check the email for the reset link and click on it.
positive.expected_result: The user is directed to the password reset page where they can enter a new password.

positive.title: Successfully logging in with the new password after resetting it
steps: 1. Reset the password using a valid email and validate the reset link as described in TC-P02.
2. Enter a new password in the password reset page and submit it.
3. Navigate to the login page.
4. Enter the registered email address and the new password.
5. Click the 'Login' button.
positive.expected_result: The user is successfully logged in with the new password.

positive.title: Reset password multiple times using the same email and validate the latest reset link
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
4. Request another password reset by repeating steps 1-3.
5. Check the email for the latest reset link and click on it.
positive.expected_result: The user is directed to the password reset page where they can enter a new password.

positive.title: Reset password and validate that the previous reset link is invalidated
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
4. Request another password reset by repeating steps 1-3.
5. Attempt to use the first reset link received.
positive.expected_result: The previous reset link is no longer valid and cannot be used to reset the password.

negative.title: Reset password with an invalid email format
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an invalid email format (e.g., 'userexample.com') in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email format is invalid.

negative.title: Reset password with an email that is not registered
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter an unregistered email address in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is not registered.

negative.title: Reset password with an empty email field
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Leave the email field empty.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email field is required.

negative.title: Reset password and make sure the old password is no longer valid
steps: 1. Reset the password using a valid email and validate the reset link as described in TC-P02.
2. Enter a new password in the password reset page and submit it.
3. Navigate to the login page.
4. Enter the registered email address and the old password.
5. Click the 'Login' button.
negative.expected_result: The old password is no longer valid for logging in.

negative.title: Reset password with a short password that does not meet the minimum length requirement
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
4. Check the email for the reset link and click on it.
5. Enter a new password that is shorter than the minimum length requirement and submit it.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password does not meet the minimum length requirement.

edge.title: Reset password with a password that is the same as the previous password
steps: 1. Reset the password using a valid email and validate the reset link as described in TC-P02.
2. Enter the same password as the previous one in the password reset page and submit it.
edge.expected_result: the password was reser successfully reset, but the user is prompted to choose a different password since it cannot be the same as the previous one.

edge.title: Reset password in low internet connectivity and validate the reset link
steps: 1. Navigate to the password reset page.
2. Enter a registered email address in the email field.
3. Click the 'Reset Password' button.
4. Simulate low internet connectivity during the password reset process.
5. Check the email for the reset link and attempt to use it.
edge.expected_result: The reset link is received and can be used successfully to reset the password, even with low internet connectivity.
